# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About JERSEY BEAR
An online retail store focused on selling soccer shirts and football jerseys, catering to soccer enthusiasts, fans, and players. The store is optimized for conversions and a smooth buying experience.

## Target Audience
- soccer fans and players
- אוהדי כדורגל ושחקנים
- קבוצות כדורגל נוער
- רוכשי מתנות לאוהדי כדורגל

## Industry
E-commerce / Sports Apparel
